events.text: Marriott opened two theme parks called Marriotts Great America in California and Illinois.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1976 , Marriott opened two theme parks called Marriotts Great America in California and Illinois .

events.text: The Illinois park was sold to Six Flags.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the one in Illinois was sold to Six Flags in 1984 .

events.text: Both parks were sold in the mid-1980s.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Both parks were sold in the mid-1980s
